edition.authority: Second Vatican Council; Pope Paul VI
edition.notes: The official Latin Acta constituent contains numbered articles 1-24 on printed pp. 145-151, followed by the promulgation formula, date, papal and conciliar subscriptions, continuation notice, and notarial attestations through printed p. 157.
edition.title: Decretum de instrumentis communicationis socialis Inter mirifica

passages.context: The Decree's complete numbered Latin body, beginning with article 1 on printed p. 145 and ending with article 24 on printed p. 151 immediately before the promulgation formula.
passages.notes: The beginning, numbered sequence, article-24 endpoint, and transition to promulgation were checked against the exact Acta artifact. The passage excludes the promulgation and subscription apparatus and does not claim a complete diplomatic transcription or word-for-word image collation.
passages.reason: The rights record states that lawful project access to this artifact does not include redistribution from this repository.
passages.rights_basis: The Vatican portal Legal Notes, reviewed 2026-07-23 at https://www.vatican.va/content/vatican/en/legal-notes.html, limit portal content to personal and non-profit viewing and prohibit collection, reproduction, dissemination, or transfer without prior written authorization from the Dicastery for Communication. No repository redistribution permission was established.

alternate_titles: Decree on the Media of Social Communications
work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Decree on the Media of Social Communications, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 4 December 1963. It comprises numbered articles 1-24; edition records distinguish the Latin Acta witness from dated Vatican web delivery states and translations.
work.title: Inter mirifica
